You are provided with a list of Images or asked to change the images? Then do this:

Search for Images inside of the docs/ folder in .md files and replace the image with the new one.

Identify the type of image from the filename (e.g. the name of the person, where to place it, etc.) and replace it with the new one.

If the filename is cryptic or a mapping list is provided in the instructions, use the mapping list instead.
